title: Keychron Announces T1 HE Wireless Trackball Mouse
excerpt: Keychron has introduced the T1 HE wireless mouse, featuring an adjustable trackball design with a 34mm ball.
body_html:
Keychron has revealed its new T1 HE wireless mouse, which features an adjustable trackball position. Unlike the company's previous slim and compact Nape Pro trackball device introduced at CES 2026, the new T1 HE model adopts a design more comparable to existing trackball mice from brands like Kensington and Logitech.

The device is equipped with a 34mm ball that allows users to adjust its positioning. Further details regarding availability, pricing, or specific technical specifications were not included in the initial announcement.
